h:
【Scepter工作流程】CN+LoRA+Mantra，全新简单绘图工作流程！

一些非常简单的节点可以用来构建“文本到图像”或“图像到图像”的工作流程；当seed、prompt等参数一致时，得到的结果与Scepter webui完全一致，并且还带有与webui相同的CN、LoRA、Mantra功能，无需外部节点！

下载：https://github.com/modelscope/scepter

可以通过Comfyui Manager下载

o.en:
[Scepter Workflow] CN+LoRA+Mantra, a brand new simple drawing workflow!

A few very simple nodes can be used to build a "text to image" or "image to image" workflow; When the parameters such as seed and prompt are consistent, the results obtained are completely consistent with Scepter webui, and it also comes with the same CN, LoRA, and Mantra functions as webui, without the need for external nodes!

Download:https://github.com/modelscope/scepter

Can be downloaded through Comfyui Manager
